<!doctype html><html lang="fr"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,ital,wght@9..144,0,400;9..144,0,500;9..144,0,600;9..144,0,700;9..144,0,900;9..144,1,400;9..144,1,700&family=Spline+Sans+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>:root{
--ink:#1a2238;--ink-soft:#3d4663;--paper:#f4f1ea;--paper-deep:#ebe6db;--oxblood:#8c2f2a;--oxblood-soft:#b05750;--accent:#8c2f2a;--accent-soft:#b05750;--gold:#c9a054;--slate:#6b7089;--rule:#d8d1c2;--nav-active:#5DCAA5;--teal:#5DCAA5;
--nav-bg:#1a2238;
--nav-text:#f4f1ea;
--hl-amber:#ecc15a;
--hl-rose:#d27870;
--hl-mint:#7ec496;
--hl-sky:#7ea0d6;
--serif:'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
--mono:'Spline Sans Mono', monospace;
}
html.dark{
--ink:#ece7da;--ink-soft:#b6b2a6;--paper:#14161c;--paper-deep:#1d2029;--oxblood:#c75d54;--oxblood-soft:#dd857c;--accent:#c75d54;--accent-soft:#dd857c;--gold:#cda05a;--slate:#9095a6;--rule:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--nav-active:#5fa39b;--teal:#5fa39b;
}

/* reading typography lives on the chapter wrapper so it doesn't touch nav/TOC */
.book-chapter{font-size:19px;line-height:1.78;padding-bottom:130px;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
.book-chapter p{margin-bottom:26px}
.book-chapter em{font-style:italic}
.book-chapter strong{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.book-chapter a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

/* chapter opener */
.opener{padding:120px 0 70px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:64px}
.ch-eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:28px;font-weight:500}
.ch-number{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;color:var(--slate);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:10px}
.ch-title{font-size:58px;line-height:1.04;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:30px}
.ch-standfirst{font-size:23px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;max-width:92%}

/* drop cap on the lead paragraph */
.lead::first-letter{font-size:76px;line-height:.72;float:left;font-weight:600;padding:8px 14px 0 0;color:var(--accent)}
body[dir="rtl"] .lead::first-letter{float:right;padding:8px 0 0 14px}

/* section marker */
.section-marker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin:64px 0 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.section-marker::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}

/* pull quote */
.pull{font-size:30px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);margin:56px 0;padding-left:28px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* verdict (ink panel) */
.verdict{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);margin:60px -28px;padding:60px 48px;border-radius:3px}
.verdict p{font-size:29px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:0}
.verdict .accent{color:var(--gold)}

/* evidence box */
.evidence{background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;padding:30px 32px 26px;margin:44px 0}
.evidence-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:16px}
.evidence-figure{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:46px;line-height:1.05;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:14px}
.evidence-body{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}
.evidence-body p{margin-bottom:14px}.evidence-body p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.evidence-label:first-child{margin-top:0}
.evidence-source{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);letter-spacing:.04em;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.evidence-source sup{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}

/* case-study card */
.case{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:3px;margin:44px 0;overflow:hidden}
.case-head{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:22px 30px}
.case-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-soft);margin-bottom:8px}
.case-name{font-size:26px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.case-body{padding:26px 30px 28px;background:var(--paper-deep)}
.case-body p{margin-bottom:18px;font-size:18px}
.case-body p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.case-stat{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:2px;padding:4px 10px;display:inline-block;margin:0 6px 8px 0}

/* argument card (his vs mine) */
.argument{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:52px 0}
.arg-head{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:16px 28px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.arg-side{padding:24px 28px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start;background:var(--paper-deep)}
.arg-side:first-of-type{border-top:none}
.arg-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;padding-top:3px;line-height:1.4}
.arg-label.his{color:var(--slate)}
.arg-label.mine{color:var(--accent)}
.arg-text{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* footnote markers + endnotes */
sup.fn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62em;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;vertical-align:super;cursor:pointer;padding:0 1px}
.notes{margin-top:90px;padding-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.notes-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:24px}
.note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr;gap:12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px;font-family:var(--serif)}
.note-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;padding-top:2px}
.note a{color:var(--slate);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

/* dialogue */
.dialogue{margin:44px 0;padding-left:22px;border-left:2px solid var(--rule)}
.dlg-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(80px,140px) 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:18px}
.dlg-speaker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;padding-top:4px;text-align:right}
.dlg-text{font-size:19px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink)}
.dlg-aside{font-style:italic;color:var(--slate);font-size:16px;margin:6px 0 18px;padding-left:0}
body[dir="rtl"] .dialogue{padding-left:0;padding-right:22px;border-left:none;border-right:2px solid var(--rule)}
body[dir="rtl"] .dlg-speaker{text-align:left}
@media(max-width:600px){.dlg-line{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px}.dlg-speaker{text-align:left;padding-top:0}}

/* closing line */
.closer{font-size:27px;line-height:1.42;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);margin:70px 0 0;padding:38px 0 0;border-top:3px double var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.closer .accent{color:var(--accent)}

/* epigraph (opening quote) */
.epigraph{margin:40px 0 52px;text-align:center;max-width:560px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.epigraph-text{font-size:24px;line-height:1.45;font-style:italic;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.epigraph-cite{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-top:18px}

/* figure (one or many images + caption) */
.figure{margin:44px 0;text-align:center}
.figure-imgs{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.figure-item{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;max-width:100%}
.figure-item img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:3px;display:block}
.figure-item-cap{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--slate);margin-top:7px;line-height:1.45}
/* solo: one centred image */
.figure-single .figure-item{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
/* row: side by side, equal share unless an image sets its own % */
.figure-row .figure-imgs{flex-wrap:nowrap}
.figure-row .figure-item{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}
.figure-row .figure-item img{width:100%;object-fit:cover}
/* column: stacked vertically */
.figure-column .figure-imgs{flex-direction:column;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center}
.figure-column .figure-item{width:100%}
/* grid: multi-column */
.figure-grid .figure-imgs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr))}
.figure-grid .figure-item{width:100%}
.figure-grid .figure-item img{width:100%}
/* carousel: a draggable strip with arrows + fading edges */
.figure-carousel-wrap{position:relative}
.figure-carousel .figure-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;cursor:grab;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.figure-carousel .figure-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;height:0;width:0}
.figure-carousel .figure-scroll.drag{cursor:grabbing;scroll-behavior:auto;user-select:none}
.figure-carousel .figure-imgs{flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:flex-start;width:max-content;padding:2px}
.figure-carousel .figure-item{flex:0 0 auto;width:300px}
.figure-carousel .figure-item img{width:100%}
.figure-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:3;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-size:22px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:opacity .25s,background .15s}
.figure-nav:hover{background:var(--paper-deep)}
.figure-nav-l{left:6px}.figure-nav-r{right:6px}
.figure-carousel-wrap.at-start .figure-nav-l,.figure-carousel-wrap.at-end .figure-nav-r,.figure-carousel-wrap.no-scroll .figure-nav{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.figure-small{max-width:300px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.figure-medium{max-width:520px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.figure-large{max-width:780px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.figure-full{max-width:100%}
.figure-carousel.figure-small,.figure-carousel.figure-medium,.figure-carousel.figure-large{max-width:none}
.figure-cap{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:600px){.figure-row .figure-imgs{flex-wrap:wrap}}

/* free-form chapter canvas (Layout mode) */
.book-chapter.canvas-chapter{max-width:none;margin:0;padding:0}
/* keep the chapter opener (title) in the centred reading column even though the canvas is full-width */
.book-chapter.canvas-chapter>.opener{max-width:var(--content-width,720px);margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
.ch-canvas-main{margin:0;padding:0}
.ch-canvas-fit{position:relative;width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.ch-canvas{position:relative;transform-origin:top left}
.layout-item{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:visible;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
/* Un element masque par l'auteur. Le livre construit ne le contient jamais —
   le rendu s'arrete avant — et cette regle ne sert donc qu'a l'apercu de
   Studio, ou il faut bien pouvoir le retrouver pour le rallumer. */
.layout-item.li-masque{opacity:.28;filter:grayscale(1)}
/* tables inside a recoloured layout element follow that element's ink/rule */
.layout-item .md-table th,.layout-item table th{color:var(--ink)}
.layout-item .md-table td,.layout-item table td{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.layout-item table th,.layout-item table td,.layout-item .md-table-bordered table,.layout-item .md-table-bordered th,.layout-item .md-table-bordered td{border-color:var(--rule)}
.layout-item>*{min-height:0}
.layout-item>:first-child{margin-top:0}
.layout-item>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.layout-item img{max-width:100%}
.layout-item .figure{margin:0;flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0}
.layout-item .figure-imgs{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;align-items:center}
.layout-item .figure-item img{max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.layout-item .media{margin:0}
.layout-item .media-el,.layout-item video{max-height:100%}
/* canvas content is positioned, not scroll-revealed — always show it */
.ch-canvas .reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}

/* Arabic / Quran passage */
.arabic-text{direction:rtl;text-align:right;font-family:'Amiri','Scheherazade New',serif;font-size:1.5em;line-height:2.15;color:var(--ink);margin:34px 0}
.arabic-text[data-font="quran"]{font-family:'Amiri Quran','Amiri',serif;font-size:1.7em;line-height:2.5;text-align:center}
.arabic-text[data-font="kufi"]{font-family:'Reem Kufi','Amiri',serif}

/* raw HTML — isolated in a sandboxed iframe so it can't affect the page */
.rawhtml{margin:40px 0}
.rawhtml-frame{width:100%;border:0;display:block;background:transparent;min-height:24px}
.layout-item .rawhtml{margin:0}
.layout-item .rawhtml-frame{height:100%}

/* media (audio / video) */
.media{margin:44px 0;text-align:center}
.media-el{max-width:100%;display:block;margin:0 auto;border-radius:6px}
video.media-el{width:100%;background:#000;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.media-audio{width:100%;height:44px}

/* images inside prose tables */
.book-chapter table img{max-width:150px;height:auto;border-radius:4px;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block}

/* callout / aside note */
.callout{background:var(--paper-deep);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);border-radius:3px;padding:22px 26px;margin:40px 0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.callout p{margin-bottom:14px}.callout p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.callout strong{color:var(--ink)}
body[dir="rtl"] .callout{border-left:none;border-right:3px solid var(--gold)}

/* subheading */
.subhead{font-size:27px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);margin:52px 0 18px}

/* verse / poem */
.verse{font-style:italic;font-size:19px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink);margin:40px 0;padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);white-space:pre-wrap}
body[dir="rtl"] .verse{border-left:none;border-right:1px solid var(--rule);padding-left:0;padding-right:28px}

/* scene break (within a chapter) */
.scene-break{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin:54px 0;color:var(--accent);font-size:12px}
.scene-break::before,.scene-break::after{content:'';width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}

/* stat (single big figure) */
.stat{margin:44px 0;text-align:center}
.stat-figure{font-size:64px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.stat-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px}

/* letter / epistolary */
.letter{background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:3px;padding:34px 38px;margin:44px 0;font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.letter p{margin-bottom:18px}.letter p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* tables */
.book-chapter table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:40px 0;font-size:16px}
.book-chapter th,.book-chapter td{text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.book-chapter th{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-weight:600}
.book-chapter td{color:var(--ink-soft)}
body[dir="rtl"] .book-chapter th,body[dir="rtl"] .book-chapter td{text-align:right}
/* table outline styles (the :::table wrapper) */
.md-table{margin:40px 0}
.md-table table{margin:0}
.md-table-bordered table{border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.md-table-bordered th,.md-table-bordered td{border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.md-table-striped th,.md-table-striped td{border-bottom:0}
.md-table-striped tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td{background:var(--paper-deep)}
.md-table-minimal th,.md-table-minimal td{border-bottom:0}
.md-table-minimal th{border-bottom:2px solid var(--rule)}
.md-table-boxed{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.md-table-boxed th,.md-table-boxed td{padding:12px 16px}
.md-table-boxed th{background:var(--paper-deep)}
.md-table-boxed td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.md-table-boxed tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}

/* lists */
.book-chapter ul,.book-chapter ol{margin:0 0 26px 1.3em}
.book-chapter li{margin-bottom:9px;line-height:1.7}

@media (max-width:600px){
  .book-chapter{font-size:18px}
  .epigraph-text{font-size:20px}
  .subhead{font-size:22px}
  .stat-figure{font-size:48px}
  .letter{padding:24px 22px}
  .ch-title{font-size:40px}
  .ch-standfirst{font-size:20px;max-width:100%}
  .opener{padding:70px 0 48px}
  .pull{font-size:24px}
  .verdict{margin:48px -20px;padding:44px 28px}
  .verdict p{font-size:23px}
  .arg-side{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
  .closer{font-size:23px}
  .lead::first-letter{font-size:62px}
}

/* ── reader font-size control: --reading-scale multiplies the prose sizes ── */
:root{--reading-scale:1}
.book-chapter{font-size:calc(19px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .ch-standfirst{font-size:calc(23px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .pull{font-size:calc(30px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .verdict p{font-size:calc(29px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .evidence-body{font-size:calc(18px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .case-body p{font-size:calc(18px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .dlg-text{font-size:calc(19px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .callout{font-size:calc(17px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .letter{font-size:calc(18px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .closer{font-size:calc(27px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .verse{font-size:calc(19px * var(--reading-scale))}
.book-chapter .epigraph-text{font-size:calc(24px * var(--reading-scale))}
@media (max-width:600px){ .book-chapter{font-size:calc(18px * var(--reading-scale))} }


.iw{margin:44px 0}
.iw-card{background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;padding:22px 24px}
.iw-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:600}
.iw-err{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-btn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:9px 16px;cursor:pointer}
.iw-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}

/* charts */
.iw-chart{width:100%}
.iw-chart text.iw-ax{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;fill:var(--slate)}
.iw-chart .iw-bar,.iw-chart .iw-dot{transition:opacity .15s}.iw-chart .iw-bar:hover,.iw-chart .iw-dot:hover{opacity:.78}
.iw-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:14px}
.iw-leg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:.04em}
.iw-leg span{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block}
.iw-leg.off{opacity:.4;text-decoration:line-through}

/* timeline — vertical rail */
.iwt-line{position:relative;margin:2px 0 0;padding-left:36px}
.iwt-line::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:11px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--rule)}
.iwt-item{position:relative;padding-bottom:30px}
.iwt-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.iwt-marker{position:absolute;left:-36px;top:1px;width:24px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.iwt-marker span{width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--paper-deep);transition:transform .15s}
.iwt-item:hover .iwt-marker span{transform:scale(1.18)}
.iwt-date{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.iwt-h{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;margin:3px 0 0;line-height:1.25}
.iwt-b{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:9px}
.iwt-media{margin-top:11px}
.iwt-img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
video.iwt-img{width:100%}
.iwt-audio{width:100%;height:40px}
.iwt-frame{width:100%;height:300px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#fff}
@media(max-width:600px){.iwt-frame{height:220px}}
/* alternate layout: events zig-zag either side of a centred rail (wide screens) */
@media(min-width:680px){
  .iwt-alt .iwt-line{padding-left:0}
  .iwt-alt .iwt-line::before{left:50%;margin-left:-1px}
  .iwt-alt .iwt-item{width:50%;box-sizing:border-box;padding-bottom:36px}
  .iwt-alt .iwt-item:nth-child(odd){margin-right:50%;padding-right:32px;text-align:right}
  .iwt-alt .iwt-item:nth-child(even){margin-left:50%;padding-left:32px;text-align:left}
  .iwt-alt .iwt-marker{width:24px;top:2px}

  .iwt-alt .iwt-item:nth-child(odd) .iwt-img{margin-left:auto;margin-right:0}
}
/* horizontal layout: a draggable strip of cards with fading edge shadows */
.iwt-horiz .iwt-wrap{position:relative}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;cursor:grab;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;height:0;width:0}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-scroll.drag{cursor:grabbing;scroll-behavior:auto;user-select:none}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-track{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;padding:8px 2px 14px;width:max-content;position:relative}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;top:15px;height:2px;background:var(--rule)}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-item{position:relative;flex:0 0 260px;width:260px;padding:0 22px 0 0;box-sizing:border-box}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-marker{position:relative;left:0;top:0;width:auto;justify-content:flex-start;margin-bottom:14px}
.iwt-horiz .iwt-img{max-height:180px}

.iwt-edge-l{left:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--paper) 12%,transparent)}
.iwt-edge-r{right:0;background:linear-gradient(270deg,var(--paper) 12%,transparent)}
.iwt-wrap.at-start .iwt-edge-l{opacity:0}
.iwt-wrap.at-end .iwt-edge-r{opacity:0}

/* universal stat card */

.iw-statcard .isc-head{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.iw-statcard .isc-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--isc-accent);margin-bottom:5px}
.iw-statcard .isc-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.iw-statcard .isc-body{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px}
.iw-statcard .isc-facts{margin:13px 0 0}
.iw-statcard .isc-fact{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:14px}

.iw-statcard .isc-fact dt{color:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.iw-statcard .isc-fact dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;text-align:right}

.iw-statcard .isc-stat-head span:first-child{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-statcard .isc-stat-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-statcard .isc-bar{height:9px;background:var(--paper-deep);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}

/* tier list */
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-board{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-row{display:flex;min-height:64px}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-label{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:64px;max-width:150px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:#1a1a1a;padding:4px 8px;outline:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.15}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-label:focus{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-drop{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:6px;background:var(--paper-deep);align-content:flex-start}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-over{outline:2px dashed var(--accent);outline-offset:-2px}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-poolh{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin:12px 0 5px}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-pool{border:1px dashed var(--rule);border-radius:8px;min-height:78px}
.iwtl-chip{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;padding:5px;width:66px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none;font-size:11px;text-align:center;line-height:1.2}

.iw-tierlist .iwtl-chip.iwtl-dragging{opacity:.3}
.iwtl-ghost{cursor:grabbing;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-reset{margin-top:12px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--slate);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-quizbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-show{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--slate);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 13px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-show:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.iw-tierlist .iwtl-score.ok{color:#3a8a5a}.iw-tierlist .iwtl-score.no{color:var(--accent)}
.iwtl-chip.iwtl-correct{outline:2px solid #3a8a5a;outline-offset:1px}
.iwtl-chip.iwtl-wrong{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}

/* branching path */
.iw-branch .iwb-trail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.iw-branch .iwb-text{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
.iw-branch .iwb-node:not(.iwb-cur){opacity:.5}
.iw-branch .iwb-node:not(.iwb-cur) .iwb-text{font-size:15px}
.iw-branch .iwb-choices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.iw-branch .iwb-choice{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px;background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 16px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;text-align:left}
.iw-branch .iwb-choice:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.iw-branch .iwb-end{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px}
.iw-branch .iwb-restart{margin-top:18px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--slate);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 13px;cursor:pointer}

/* sheet music */
.iw-sheet .iwsm-staffwrap{position:relative}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-scroll{overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-svg{display:block;max-width:none;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-play{margin-bottom:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-play:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-chords{overflow-x:auto}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-cl{margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-chord{margin:0;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;white-space:pre;line-height:1.2}
.iw-sheet .iwsm-lyric{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16px;white-space:pre;line-height:1.3}

/* cartesian grapher */
.iw-graph .iwg-plot{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.iw-graph .iwg-svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.iw-graph .iwg-grid{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1;opacity:.55}
.iw-graph .iwg-axis{stroke:var(--ink-soft);stroke-width:1.4}
.iw-graph .iwg-lbl{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}
.iw-graph .iwg-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 18px;margin-top:12px}
.iw-graph .iwg-leg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-graph .iwg-leg i{width:16px;height:3px;border-radius:2px}
.iw-graph .iwg-leg em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}

/* interactive simulation */
.iw-sim .iwsim-vars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.iw-sim .iwsim-vh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px}
.iw-sim .iwsim-vh em{color:var(--slate);font-style:normal;font-size:12px}
.iw-sim .iwsim-vh b{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sim .iwsim-var input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sim .iwsim-outs{margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.iw-sim .iwsim-out{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}
.iw-sim .iwsim-ol{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-soft)}.iw-sim .iwsim-ol em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
.iw-sim .iwsim-ov{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
/* labeled diagram */
/* ── geometry figure ── */
.iw-geo .iwgeo-wrap{overflow-x:auto}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-svg{width:100%;max-width:620px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-grid line{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:.6;opacity:.55}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-ax line{stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:1.2}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-l{fill:var(--ink);font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke fill;stroke:var(--paper-deep);stroke-width:3px}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-m{fill:var(--ink-soft);font-family:var(--mono);paint-order:stroke fill;stroke:var(--paper-deep);stroke-width:3px}
.iw-geo .iwgeo-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft)}
/* Le graphique : un paragraphe avant, une legende apres. La legende porte la
   source ou la lecture a retenir — un graphique sans source ne prouve rien. */
.iwch-intro{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iwch-note{margin-top:10px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── method (worked solution) ── */
.iw-method .iwme-head{margin-bottom:10px}
.iw-method .iwme-kick{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-method .iwme-head h3{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:700}
.iw-method .iwme-prob{padding:11px 14px;background:var(--paper);border-left:3px solid var(--slate);border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
.iw-method .iwme-steps{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:26px;counter-reset:none}
.iw-method .iwme-step{margin-bottom:12px;transition:opacity .25s}
.iw-method .iwme-step::marker{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-method .iwme-step.hid{display:none}
/* overflow-y must be stated: when one axis is not visible the other computes to
   auto, and the taller MathML block then grows a stray vertical scrollbar */
.iw-method .iwme-expr{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;padding:4px 0 9px}
.iw-method .iwme-expr math{font-size:1.15em}
.iw-method .iwme-why{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
.iw-method .iwme-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.iw-method .iwme-actions .iw-btn[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.iw-method .iwme-ans{margin-top:14px;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,#2e7d32 11%,transparent);border-left:3px solid #2e7d32}
.iw-method .iwme-ans.hid{display:none}
.iw-method .iwme-ans>span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#2e7d32}

/* ── number line ── */
.iw-nline .iwnl-wrap{overflow-x:auto}
.iw-nline .iwnl-svg{width:100%;min-width:420px;height:auto;display:block}
.iw-nline .iwnl-axis{stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:1.6}
.iw-nline .iwnl-arrow{fill:var(--ink)}
.iw-nline .iwnl-tick{stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:1.2}
.iw-nline .iwnl-num{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}
.iw-nline .iwnl-lab{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.iw-nline .iwnl-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ── statistics ── */
.iw-stats .iwst-sum{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(132px,1fr));gap:2px 16px;margin:0 0 14px}
/* every measure is a button, because every measure explains itself */
.iw-stats .iwst-tile{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;width:100%;
  padding:5px 6px;border:0;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--rule);background:none;font:inherit;text-align:left;
  cursor:help;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.iw-stats .iwst-tile:hover,.iw-stats .iwst-tile:focus-visible{background:var(--paper-deep);border-bottom-color:var(--accent);outline:none}
.iw-stats .iwst-tile.on{background:var(--paper-deep);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}
.iw-stats .iwst-dt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-stats .iwst-tile.on .iwst-dt{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-stats .iwst-sym{text-transform:none}
.iw-stats .iwst-dd{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-stats .iwst-why{min-height:66px;padding:11px 14px;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--paper-deep);border-left:2.5px solid var(--accent)}
.iw-stats .iwst-why b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:4px}
.iw-stats .iwst-why span{display:block;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-stats .iwst-why i{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;
  line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-stats .iwst-hint{color:var(--slate) !important;font-style:italic}
.iw-stats .iwst-box,.iw-stats .iwst-hist,.iw-stats .iwst-dot,.iw-stats .iwst-cum{width:100%;max-width:620px;height:auto;display:block;margin:6px auto 0}
.iw-stats .iwst-t{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px}
.iw-stats .iwst-k{fill:var(--ink);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:700}
/* hovering a measure lights up the part of the picture it is talking about */
.iw-stats .iwst-mk{transition:stroke-width .15s,fill-opacity .15s}
.iw-stats .iwst-mk.on{stroke:var(--gold) !important;stroke-width:4}
.iw-stats rect.iwst-mk.on{fill:var(--gold);fill-opacity:.22;stroke-width:2.4}
.iw-stats circle.iwst-out.on{stroke-width:2.4}
.iw-stats .iwst-read{opacity:.85}
.iw-stats .iwst-cap{margin-top:7px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-stats .iwst-stem{margin:14px auto 0;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px}
.iw-stats .iwst-stem caption{caption-side:top;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);padding-bottom:7px}
.iw-stats .iwst-stem th{padding:3px 12px 3px 4px;text-align:right;border-right:1.5px solid var(--rule);color:var(--accent)}
.iw-stats .iwst-stem td{padding:3px 4px 3px 12px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-stats .iwst-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ── probability tree ── */
.iw-ptree .iwpt-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-scroll{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
/* the branches are SVG, the words are HTML on top of them, because an outcome
   can be a phrase and SVG text does not wrap */
.iw-ptree .iwpt-stage{position:relative}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-br,.iw-ptree .iwpt-dot{transition:opacity .18s,stroke-width .18s}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-lab{position:absolute;transform:translateY(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;
  line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink);transition:opacity .18s,color .18s}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-lab.ev{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-p{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);min-width:34px;text-align:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);
  background:var(--paper);border-radius:9px;padding:1px 5px;transition:opacity .18s}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-leafp{position:absolute;transform:translateY(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;color:var(--slate);transition:opacity .18s,color .18s}
/* a stacked fraction, so a sixth reads as a sixth */
.iw-ptree .iwpt-fr{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;vertical-align:middle;
  line-height:1.05;font-size:.86em}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-fr b{font-weight:700}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-fr i{font-style:normal;font-weight:700;border-top:1.4px solid currentColor;padding-top:1px}
/* hovering any one representation dims everything not on that path */
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-br,.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-dot,
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-lab,.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-p,
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-seg,.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-tab tbody tr{opacity:.24}
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus [data-node].on,.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus [data-leaf].on{opacity:1}
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-br.on{stroke-width:5.5}
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-lab.on{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.iw-ptree.iwpt-focus .iwpt-tab tbody tr.on{opacity:1;background:var(--paper-deep)}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-warn{margin-top:12px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,#c0392b 11%,transparent);border-left:3px solid #c0392b}
/* the unit bar: the whole of the probability, cut into the outcomes */
.iw-ptree .iwpt-bar{display:flex;height:36px;margin-top:18px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule)}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-seg{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;
  cursor:default;transition:opacity .18s,filter .18s}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-seg+.iwpt-seg{box-shadow:inset 1.5px 0 0 var(--paper)}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-seg em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 4px}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-seg.ev{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--gold)}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-barcap{margin-top:6px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-ptree .iwpt-event{margin-top:14px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper-deep);
  border-left:2.5px solid var(--gold);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}

/* poll */
.iwp-opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.iwp-opt{position:relative;text-align:left;padding:13px 16px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
.iwp-opt:hover:not(.done){border-color:var(--accent)}
.iwp-opt.done{cursor:default}
.iwp-bar{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(140,47,42,.16);z-index:0;transition:width .5s}
.iwp-opt.mine .iwp-bar{background:rgba(140,47,42,.30)}
.iwp-l,.iwp-pct{position:relative;z-index:1}.iwp-pct{float:right;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--slate)}
body[dir="rtl"] .iwp-pct{float:left}
.iwp-foot{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:.06em}

/* quiz */
.iwq-q{padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}.iwq-q:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.iwq-qt{font-weight:600;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:10px}
.iwq-opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iwq-opt input{accent-color:var(--accent);width:17px;height:17px}
.iwq-q.ok .iwq-qt{color:#3a8a5a}.iwq-q.no .iwq-qt{color:var(--accent)}
.iwq-img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:320px;height:auto;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--rule);margin:4px 0 12px}
.iwq-body{margin-top:4px}
.iwq-cloze{font-size:17px;line-height:2.15}
.iwq-blank,.iwq-cell{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;padding:5px 9px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
.iwq-blank{margin:0 3px}
.iwq-blank:focus,.iwq-cell:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
select.iwq-blank,select.iwq-cell{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px}
.iwq-blank.bk-ok,.iwq-cell.bk-ok{border-color:#3a8a5a;background:rgba(125,196,150,.18)}
.iwq-blank.bk-no,.iwq-cell.bk-no{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(214,120,112,.16)}
.iwq-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:4px 0}
.iwq-table th,.iwq-table td{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:8px 10px;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle}
.iwq-table th{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);background:var(--paper)}
.iwq-table .iwq-cell,.iwq-table select.iwq-cell{width:100%}
.iwq-explain{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--slate);background:var(--paper);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:10px}
.iwq-actions{margin-top:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.iwq-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px}.iwq-score.ok{color:#3a8a5a}.iwq-score.no{color:var(--accent)}

/* code + live preview */
.iw-code{padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.iwco-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:9px 14px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.iwco-lang{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8}
.iwco-head .iw-btn{padding:6px 12px}
.iwco-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:240px}
.iw-code.stack .iwco-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.iwco-editor{position:relative;background:#0f1117;overflow:auto}
.iwco-hl,.iwco-ta{margin:0;padding:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;white-space:pre;tab-size:2;border:0}
.iwco-hl{color:#e6e6e6;min-height:240px}
.iwco-ta{position:absolute;inset:0;color:transparent;background:transparent;caret-color:#fff;resize:none;outline:none;overflow:hidden}
.iwco-hl .hl-k{color:#c792ea}.iwco-hl .hl-s{color:#c3e88d}.iwco-hl .hl-c{color:#6b7089;font-style:italic}
.iwco-hl .hl-n{color:#f78c6c}.iwco-hl .hl-b{color:#82aaff}
.iwco-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.iwco-head .iwco-reset{background:none;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:inherit;opacity:.75}
.iwco-head .iwco-reset:hover{opacity:1}
iframe.iwco-out{border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fff;width:100%;min-height:240px}
/* Python has no page to render, so the right-hand pane is a terminal */
.iwco-term{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:240px;
  border-left:1px solid var(--rule);background:#0b0d13}
.iwco-termhead{padding:7px 16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b7089;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.iwco-term.bad .iwco-termhead{color:#ff8a80}
pre.iwco-out{flex:1;margin:0;padding:14px 16px;min-height:0;overflow:auto;border:0;background:transparent;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#d7dbe6;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word}
.iwco-err{margin:0;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,138,128,.35);
  background:rgba(255,138,128,.10);color:#ff8a80;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;
  white-space:pre-wrap}
.iw-code.stack iframe.iwco-out,.iw-code.stack .iwco-term{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
@media(max-width:600px){.iwco-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  iframe.iwco-out,.iwco-term{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}}

/* reveal box (collapse / flip / scratch) */
.iw-reveal{overflow:visible}
.iwr-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;cursor:pointer}
.iwr-head:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iwr-chev{margin-left:auto;color:var(--accent);transition:transform .2s}
.iw-reveal.on .iwr-chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.iwr-body{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;background:var(--paper-deep)}
.iwr-body[hidden]{display:none}
/* flip */
.iwr-flip{perspective:1200px;cursor:pointer;min-height:150px}
.iwr-fi{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:150px;transition:transform .55s;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.iw-reveal .iwr-flip.on .iwr-fi{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.iwr-face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;border-radius:10px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.5}
.iwr-front{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.iwr-back{background:var(--paper-deep);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--rule);transform:rotateY(180deg)}
/* scratch */
.iwr-scratch{position:relative;min-height:150px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iwr-under{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:var(--paper-deep);color:var(--ink);font-size:19px;line-height:1.5}
.iwr-cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:crosshair;touch-action:none}
.iwr-hint{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;transition:opacity .3s}

/* ── annotated text ── */
.iw-ann .iwann-kick{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.iw-ann .iwann-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;margin:0 0 12px}
.iw-ann .iwann-doc{background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;padding:16px 20px}
.iw-ann .iwann-text p{margin:0 0 .7em;line-height:1.75}
.iw-ann .iwann-text p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.iw-ann .iwann-lines{margin:0;padding-left:2.2em;line-height:1.85}
.iw-ann .iwann-lines li{padding-left:4px}
.iw-ann .iwann-lines li::marker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-ann .iwann-cite{margin-top:12px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px dashed var(--rule);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-ann mark.iwann-m{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--am) 22%,transparent);color:inherit;border-bottom:2px solid var(--am);
  border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;padding:1px 1px 0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.iw-ann mark.iwann-m:hover,.iw-ann mark.iwann-m.on{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--am) 42%,transparent)}
.iw-ann mark.iwann-m sup{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--am);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:super}
.iw-ann .iwann-notes{margin-top:16px}
.iw-ann .iwann-notes h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin:0 0 8px}
.iw-ann .iwann-notes ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:7px}
.iw-ann .iwann-n{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  border-left:3px solid var(--am);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.iw-ann .iwann-n:hover,.iw-ann .iwann-n.on{background:var(--paper-deep)}
.iw-ann .iwann-n>b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:var(--am);
  min-width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:2px}
.iw-ann .iwann-lab{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.iw-ann .iwann-note{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:2px}
.iw-ann .iwann-warn{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-ann .iwann-foot{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── Punnett square ── */
.iw-pun .iwpun-intro{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-pun .iwpun-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:4px;margin:0 auto;font-family:var(--mono)}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t th{background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;
  padding:9px 14px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);min-width:56px}
.iw-pun .iwpun-corner{background:transparent;border:0;position:relative;min-width:104px;height:52px}
.iw-pun .iwpun-corner span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;text-align:left}
.iw-pun .iwpun-corner span:first-child{text-align:right}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t td{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;padding:10px 14px;text-align:center;
  background:var(--paper);min-width:72px}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t td.iwpun-has{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 16%,var(--paper));border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 45%,var(--rule))}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t td b{display:block;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.iw-pun .iwpun-t td i{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-style:normal;font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px}
.iw-pun .iwpun-ratio{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-pun .iwpun-rl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-pun .iwpun-r{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;font-size:14px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc,var(--rule)) 45%,var(--rule));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc,var(--paper-deep)) 12%,var(--paper))}
.iw-pun .iwpun-r b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;color:var(--pc,var(--accent))}
.iw-pun .iwpun-r em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-pun .iwpun-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── pedigree ── */
.iw-ped .iwped-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}
.iw-ped .iwped-svg{display:block;width:100%;min-width:420px;height:auto}
.iw-ped .iwped-l{stroke:var(--ink-soft);stroke-width:1.6;fill:none}
.iw-ped .iwped-s{fill:var(--paper);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:2}
.iw-ped .iwped-s.aff{fill:var(--ink)}
.iw-ped .iwped-dot{fill:var(--ink)}
.iw-ped .iwped-dead{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}
.iw-ped .iwped-t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;fill:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-ped .iwped-g{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--slate)}
.iw-ped .iwped-key{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-ped .iwped-key span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.iw-ped .iwped-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── exercise sheet ── */
.iw-ex .iwex-kick{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:5px}
.iw-ex .iwex-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;margin:0 0 8px}
.iw-ex .iwex-intro{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-ex .iwex-list{margin:0;padding-left:1.6em;display:grid;gap:12px}
.iw-ex .iwex-q{padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:9px;background:var(--paper-deep);transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
.iw-ex .iwex-q.ok{border-color:#5fa39b;background:color-mix(in srgb,#5fa39b 10%,var(--paper-deep))}
.iw-ex .iwex-q.no{border-color:var(--accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 8%,var(--paper-deep))}
.iw-ex .iwex-q::marker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-ex .iwex-qt{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
.iw-ex .iwex-pts{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--slate);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-ex .iwex-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:8px}
.iw-ex .iwex-a{flex:0 1 220px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
.iw-ex .iwex-a:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-ex .iwex-u{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-ex .iwex-mark{width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 auto}
.iw-ex .iwex-q.ok .iwex-mark::before{content:"✓";color:#4d8f86;font-weight:700}
.iw-ex .iwex-q.no .iwex-mark::before{content:"✕";color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.iw-ex .iwex-hb{margin-top:8px}
.iw-ex .iwex-hint{margin-top:7px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:10px}
.iw-ex .iwex-sol,.iw-ex .iwex-shown{margin-top:9px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;background:var(--paper);
  border:1px dashed var(--rule);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 12px}
.iw-ex .iwex-sol b,.iw-ex .iwex-shown b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:3px}
.iw-ex .iwex-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:15px}
.iw-ex .iwex-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.iw-ex .iwex-score.ok{color:#4d8f86}
.iw-ex .iwex-score.no{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-ex .iwex-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── glossary ── */
.iw-glo .iwglo-intro{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-glo .iwglo-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:13px}
.iw-glo .iwglo-in{flex:1;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper-deep);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
.iw-glo .iwglo-in:focus{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--paper)}
.iw-glo .iwglo-count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-glo .iwglo-l{margin:0}
.iw-glo .iwglo-2{columns:2;column-gap:26px}
.iw-glo .iwglo-2 .iwglo-e{break-inside:avoid}
.iw-glo .iwglo-letter{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);
  margin:16px 0 5px;padding-bottom:3px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-glo .iwglo-e{padding:6px 0}
.iw-glo .iwglo-e dt{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.iw-glo .iwglo-e dt em{font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:13px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-glo .iwglo-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--paper-deep);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-glo .iwglo-e dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ── flashcards ── */
.iw-fc .iwfc-card{perspective:1200px;height:210px;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
.iw-fc .iwfc-card:focus-visible .iwfc-inner{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--gold)}
.iw-fc .iwfc-inner{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;transition:transform .5s;transform-style:preserve-3d;border-radius:12px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-card.flip .iwfc-inner{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.iw-fc .iwfc-face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;gap:9px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-front{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.iw-fc .iwfc-back{background:var(--paper-deep);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--rule);transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.iw-fc .iwfc-tx{font-size:19px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:500;overflow:auto;max-height:100%}
.iw-fc .iwfc-back .iwfc-tx{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.6}
.iw-fc .iwfc-front i{position:absolute;bottom:13px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.62}
.iw-fc .iwfc-tag{position:absolute;top:12px;left:14px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 7px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin-top:12px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-pos{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);min-width:64px;text-align:center}
.iw-fc .iwfc-judge{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:9px;margin-top:10px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-stat{text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);min-height:1.4em;margin-top:8px}
.iw-fc .iwfc-note{margin-top:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic;text-align:center}

/* ── scatter plot ── */
.iw-sc .iwsc-wrap{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}
.iw-sc .iwsc-svg{display:block;width:100%;min-width:420px;height:auto}
.iw-sc .iwsc-grid{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1;opacity:.6}
.iw-sc .iwsc-ax{stroke:var(--ink-soft);stroke-width:1.6}
.iw-sc .iwsc-n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;fill:var(--slate)}
