.iw-sb .iwsb-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:15px}
.iw-sb .iwsb-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.iw-sb .iwsb-score.ok{color:#4d8f86}.iw-sb .iwsb-score.no{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sb .iwsb-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── rubric ── */
.iw-rb .iwrb-intro{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-scroll{margin-top:14px;overflow-x:auto}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:520px}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t th,.iw-rb .iwrb-t td{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:9px 11px;vertical-align:middle}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t thead th{background:var(--paper);text-align:center;vertical-align:bottom}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t thead th span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t thead th em{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);font-style:normal;margin-top:3px}
.iw-rb .iwrb-ch{text-align:left!important;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-c{text-align:left;background:var(--paper);max-width:280px}
.iw-rb .iwrb-c b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.iw-rb .iwrb-c span{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-rb .iwrb-c i{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);font-style:normal;margin-top:4px}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody td{text-align:center}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody label{display:inline-flex;cursor:pointer}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody label i{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--rule);display:block;transition:.12s}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody label:hover i{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody input:checked+i{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3.5px var(--paper)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-t tbody input:focus-visible+i{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(140,47,42,.25)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-out{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-top:16px}
.iw-rb .iwrb-track{flex:1;min-width:120px;height:9px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--paper);overflow:hidden}
.iw-rb .iwrb-track i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--teal);transition:width .18s}
.iw-rb .iwrb-mark{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.iw-rb .iwrb-mark.ok{color:#4d8f86}.iw-rb .iwrb-mark.no{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-rb .iwrb-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── GIF / animation ── */
.iw-gif{margin:44px 0}
.iw-gif .iwgif-fig{margin:0;width:var(--gw,100%)}
.iw-gif .iwgif-center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.iw-gif .iwgif-right{margin-left:auto}
.iw-gif .iwgif-stage{position:relative;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper-deep);
  border:1px solid var(--rule);line-height:0}
.iw-gif .iwgif-hold{line-height:0}
.iw-gif .iwgif-media{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.iw-gif .iwgif-blank{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--paper-deep)}
.iw-gif .iwgif-empty{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:220px;
  border:2px dashed var(--rule);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper-deep);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.4}
/* the big badge only while paused, the small bar only on hover or focus */
.iw-gif .iwgif-play{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;
  border:0;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(20,20,24,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);transition:.15s}
.iw-gif .iwgif-play::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:53%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  border-style:solid;border-width:12px 0 12px 19px;border-color:transparent transparent transparent #fff}
.iw-gif .iwgif-play:hover{background:var(--accent);transform:scale(1.06)}
.iw-gif .iwgif-stage.on .iwgif-play{display:none}
.iw-gif .iwgif-bar{position:absolute;right:9px;bottom:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;line-height:1}
.iw-gif .iwgif-stage:hover .iwgif-bar,.iw-gif .iwgif-stage:focus-within .iwgif-bar,
.iw-gif .iwgif-stage.on .iwgif-bar{opacity:1}
.iw-gif .iwgif-b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:0;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 10px;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(20,20,24,.72);color:#fff}
.iw-gif .iwgif-b:hover{background:var(--accent)}
.iw-gif .iwgif-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 7px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(20,20,24,.55);color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.iw-gif figcaption{margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-gif figcaption em{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-style:normal}
.iw-gif .iwgif-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* imported meshes that had to be thinned to stay drawable */
.iw-3d .iw3d-facts .iw3d-warn{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-3d .iw3d-facts .iw3d-warn b{color:var(--accent)}

/* embed */
.iw-embed{margin:44px 0}
.iw-embed-frame{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;display:block;background:#fff}

/* the fair test, on the lab card */
.iw-lab .ilab-vars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px}
.iw-lab .ilab-vars>div{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;min-width:0}
.iw-lab .ilab-vars em{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-style:normal;margin-bottom:6px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-lab .ilab-vars span{display:block;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-lab .ilab-vars span+span{margin-top:3px;padding-top:3px;border-top:1px dotted var(--rule)}

/* ── keyboard: the piano as a ruler for pitch ── */
.iw-kb .iwkb-intro,.iw-cf .iwcf-intro,.iw-rg .iwrg-intro,.iw-cb .iwcb-intro{
  font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-stage{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-keys{position:relative;display:flex;height:132px;min-width:280px;
  border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;background:var(--ink)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k{font:inherit;padding:0;cursor:pointer;border:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:center}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.w{flex:1;background:#fbfaf7;border-right:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;
  min-width:22px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.w:last-child{border-right:0}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.b{position:absolute;top:0;width:calc(100% / 14 * 0.58);max-width:34px;height:60%;
  background:#14161c;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;z-index:2}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.w span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);padding-bottom:7px;
  border-radius:20px;min-width:18px;line-height:1.6}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.b span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;color:#fff;padding-bottom:5px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.on.w{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.on.w span{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;margin-bottom:6px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.on.b{background:var(--accent)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.ok.w{background:#cfe8d6}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.ok.b{background:var(--teal)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k.no{background:var(--accent) !important}
.iw-kb .iwkb-k:hover{filter:brightness(.94)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-read{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);min-height:1.8em}
.iw-kb .iwkb-read span{display:inline-block;margin-right:14px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-read i{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px}
.iw-kb .iwkb-read b.ok{color:var(--teal)}
.iw-kb .iwkb-hint{color:var(--slate);font-style:italic;font-family:inherit}
.iw-kb .iwkb-note,.iw-cf .iwcf-note,.iw-rg .iwrg-note,.iw-cb .iwcb-note{
  margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── fifths ── */
.iw-cf .iwcf-wheel{text-align:center}
.iw-cf .iwcf-wheel svg{width:min(330px,86vw);height:auto}
.iw-cf .iwcf-seg{cursor:pointer;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-width:2;transition:fill .15s}
.iw-cf .iwcf-seg.maj{fill:var(--paper-deep)}
.iw-cf .iwcf-seg.min{fill:var(--rule);opacity:.5}
.iw-cf .iwcf-seg:hover{fill:var(--accent-soft)}
.iw-cf .iwcf-seg.on{fill:var(--accent);opacity:1}
.iw-cf .iwcf-maj{fill:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}
.iw-cf .iwcf-min{fill:var(--slate);font-size:12px;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}
.iw-cf .iwcf-maj.on,.iw-cf .iwcf-min.on{fill:#fff}
.iw-cf .iwcf-c1,.iw-cf .iwcf-c2{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.14em;text-anchor:middle;text-transform:uppercase}
.iw-cf .iwcf-read{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink-soft);
  min-height:1.8em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-cf .iwcf-hint{color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}

/* ── rhythmgrid ── */
.iw-rg .iwrg-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.iw-rg .iwrg-sig{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:.95;font-family:var(--serif);
  font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-kind{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-left:4px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;
  padding:11px 14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.ok{border-left-color:var(--teal)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.short{border-left-color:var(--gold)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.over{border-left-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-notes{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;min-height:44px}
.iw-rg .iwrg-n{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:var(--paper-deep);
  border-radius:4px;min-width:0;padding:4px 0}
.iw-rg .iwrg-n.rest{background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--rule)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-n i{font-style:normal;font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-count{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:5px}
.iw-rg .iwrg-count span{flex:1;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-sum{margin-top:7px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.ok .iwrg-sum b{color:var(--teal)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.short .iwrg-sum b{color:var(--gold)}
.iw-rg .iwrg-bar.over .iwrg-sum b{color:var(--accent)}

/* ── chordbuilder ── */
.iw-cb .iwcb-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px}
.iw-cb .iwcb-sym{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:38px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);line-height:1}
.iw-cb .iwcb-facts{flex:1;min-width:190px;display:grid;gap:5px}
.iw-cb .iwcb-facts span{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-cb .iwcb-facts i{flex:0 0 104px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-style:normal;padding-top:3px}
.iw-cb .iwcb-kb{position:relative;display:flex;height:96px;border:1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;background:var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
.iw-cb .iwcb-k.w{flex:1;background:#fbfaf7;border-right:1px solid var(--ink);min-width:14px}
.iw-cb .iwcb-k.b{position:absolute;top:0;width:calc(100% / 15 * 0.56);height:60%;background:#14161c;z-index:2}
.iw-cb .iwcb-k.on.w{background:var(--accent)}
.iw-cb .iwcb-k.on.b{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #fff}

/* ── particles: the particle model ── */
.iw-pa .iwpa-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}
.iw-pa .iwpa-states,.iw-pa .iwpa-mix{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:18px}
.iw-pa figure{margin:0;min-width:0}

/* the container: a vessel, not a plain square — open at the top for a liquid,
   sealed for a gas, because that is half of what the figure is saying */
.iw-pa .iwpa-box{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper) 0%,var(--paper-deep) 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--rule),inset 0 14px 26px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-box.liquide{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--rule)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-box.liquide::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:38%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper) 60%,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.iw-pa .iwpa-box.gaz::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.05),transparent 70%)}

.iw-pa .iwpa-d{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition:left .55s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),top .55s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  box-shadow:inset -1.5px -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset 1.5px 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.iw-pa .anim .iwpa-d{animation-duration:2.4s;animation-iteration-count:infinite;
  animation-direction:alternate;animation-timing-function:ease-in-out}
.iw-pa .anim .iwpa-d.s,.iw-pa .anim.solide .iwpa-d{animation-name:iwpaS;animation-duration:1.5s}
.iw-pa .anim .iwpa-d.l,.iw-pa .anim.liquide .iwpa-d{animation-name:iwpaL;animation-duration:3s}
.iw-pa .anim .iwpa-d.g,.iw-pa .anim.gaz .iwpa-d{animation-name:iwpaG;animation-duration:2.2s}
@keyframes iwpaS{from{margin:0 0}to{margin:-1.5px 1.5px}}
@keyframes iwpaL{from{margin:0 0}to{margin:-7px 5px}}
@keyframes iwpaG{from{margin:0 0}to{margin:-22px 26px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.iw-pa .iwpa-d,.iw-pa .iwpa-m{animation:none !important}}

.iw-pa figcaption{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink);margin-top:11px;text-align:center}
.iw-pa .iwpa-st ul{list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0}
.iw-pa .iwpa-st li{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--slate);text-align:center}
.iw-pa .iwpa-st li+li{border-top:1px dotted var(--rule)}
/* pointing at one state without losing the comparison */
.iw-pa .iwpa-states.focus .iwpa-st{opacity:.45;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s}
.iw-pa .iwpa-states.focus .iwpa-st.on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-3px)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-st.on figcaption{color:var(--accent)}

/* the changes of state, as arrows in the two directions they go */
.iw-pa .iwpa-arrows{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:6px 18px;margin-top:16px;
  padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;
  letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar i{font-style:normal}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar::before{content:'';flex:0 0 26px;height:1.5px;background:currentColor;position:relative}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar::after{content:'▸';margin-left:-14px;font-size:12px;line-height:0}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar.up{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar.dn{color:var(--teal)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-ar.sub{color:var(--gold);grid-column:1/-1}

/* heat: one substance, one temperature, the same particles throughout */
.iw-pa .iwpa-heat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,240px) 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.iw-pa .iwpa-heat .iwpa-box{transition:box-shadow .4s}
.iw-pa .iwpa-heat.gaz .iwpa-box{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-state{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px}
.iw-pa .iwpa-hfacts{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.iw-pa .iwpa-hfacts li{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-hfacts li::before{content:'▸ ';color:var(--rule)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-slider{margin-top:18px}
.iw-pa .iwpa-slider input{width:100%;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.iw-pa .iwpa-scale{position:relative;height:16px;margin-top:2px}
.iw-pa .iwpa-scale span{position:absolute;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-pa .iwpa-scale span::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:-6px;width:1px;height:5px;
  background:var(--rule)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-temp{margin-top:8px;text-align:center}
.iw-pa .iwpa-temp b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-temp i{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);margin-top:2px}

/* mixture: real molecules, so "one element or two" can be seen */
.iw-pa .iwpa-m{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);line-height:0;
  transition:opacity .2s;animation-name:iwpaG;animation-duration:2.6s;
  animation-iteration-count:infinite;animation-direction:alternate;animation-timing-function:ease-in-out}
.iw-pa .iwpa-mix:not(.anim) .iwpa-m{animation:none}
.iw-pa .iwpa-m.dim{opacity:.16}
.iw-pa .iwpa-mol{overflow:visible}
.iw-pa .iwpa-mol circle{stroke:rgba(0,0,0,.35);stroke-width:.8}
.iw-pa .iwpa-bond line{stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:.85}
.iw-pa .iwpa-leg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:9px}
.iw-pa .iwpa-leg button{font:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:20px;
  padding:3px 10px;background:none;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-leg button:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-leg button.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.iw-pa .iwpa-leg em{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;opacity:.75}
.iw-pa .iwpa-verdict{margin-top:10px;text-align:center;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-verdict b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-pa .iwpa-verdict i{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-pa .iwpa-bn{margin-top:7px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;line-height:1.55}
.iw-pa .iwpa-note{margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── instrument: read the scale ── */
.iw-in .iwin-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-in .iwin-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start}
.iw-in .iwin-stage{flex:0 0 auto}
.iw-in .iwin-stage svg{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
.iw-in .iwin-ask{flex:1;min-width:210px}
.iw-in .iwin-ask label{display:block;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:9px}
.iw-in .iwin-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.iw-in .iwin-in input{font:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;width:120px;padding:7px 11px;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);outline:none;text-align:right}
.iw-in .iwin-in input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-in .iwin-in.ok input{border-color:var(--teal)}
.iw-in .iwin-in.no input{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-in .iwin-u{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-in .iwin-mark{width:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px}
.iw-in .iwin-in.ok .iwin-mark::before{content:'✓';color:var(--teal)}
.iw-in .iwin-in.no .iwin-mark::before{content:'✕';color:var(--accent)}
.iw-in .iwin-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.iw-in .iwin-why{margin-top:11px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-in .iwin-why b{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--teal)}
.iw-in .iwin-shown b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:26px;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-in .iwin-body{fill:none;stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:2}
.iw-in .iwin-fill{fill:var(--accent);opacity:.5}
.iw-in .iwin-men{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2}
.iw-in .iwin-t{stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:1}
.iw-in .iwin-t.big{stroke-width:1.8}
.iw-in .iwin-n{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;text-anchor:middle}
.iw-in .iwin-n.l{text-anchor:start}
.iw-in .iwin-arc{fill:none;stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:2}
.iw-in .iwin-needle{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round}
.iw-in .iwin-pin{fill:var(--ink)}
.iw-in .iwin-un{fill:var(--slate);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;text-anchor:middle}
.iw-in .iwin-mk{fill:var(--accent)}
.iw-in .iwin-mkl{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1.4;stroke-dasharray:4 3}
.iw-in .iwin-note{margin-top:13px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── keychart: a dichotomous key ── */
.iw-kc .iwkc-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-trail{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-crumb{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);border:1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-crumb+.iwkc-crumb::before{content:'▸ ';color:var(--rule)}
.iw-kc .iwkc-ask{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:11px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-b{font:inherit;font-size:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;flex:1;min-width:150px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 14px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
  line-height:1.5;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s}
.iw-kc .iwkc-b:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.iw-kc .iwkc-sn{margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-kc .iwkc-result{border:1.5px solid var(--teal);border-radius:9px;padding:14px 16px;text-align:center}
.iw-kc .iwkc-result span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:5px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-result b{font-size:20px;color:var(--teal)}
.iw-kc .iwkc-again{margin-top:12px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-kc .iwkc-list>.iwkc-row:first-child{border-top:0}
.iw-kc .iwkc-id{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.iw-kc .iwkc-opt{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:baseline;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;padding:2px 0;min-width:0}
.iw-kc .iwkc-opt i{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-style:normal;color:var(--slate);flex:0 0 auto}
.iw-kc .iwkc-opt b{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);
  white-space:nowrap;padding-left:10px}
.iw-kc .iwkc-note{margin-top:13px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── karyotype: pairs, side by side ── */
.iw-ky .iwky-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-ky .iwky-sets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px}
.iw-ky .iwky-set{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 12px 10px}
.iw-ky .iwky-lb{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:10px}
.iw-ky .iwky-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell{flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;padding:2px 0 1px;
  transition:background .15s}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell:hover{background:var(--paper-deep)}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell.on{background:var(--paper-deep);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent)}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell svg{display:block;margin:0 auto;overflow:visible}
.iw-ky .iwky-c path{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:1px}
.iw-ky .iwky-cell.odd span{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.iw-ky .iwky-sex{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px}
.iw-ky .iwky-sn{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-ky .iwky-read{margin-top:13px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);min-height:1.7em;line-height:1.7}
.iw-ky .iwky-read b{margin-right:8px}
.iw-ky .iwky-read span{display:inline-block;margin-right:14px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px}
.iw-ky .iwky-read span.odd{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.iw-ky .iwky-read i{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-ky .iwky-hint,.iw-cl .iwcl-hint{color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-ky .iwky-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── cladogram: shared characters, not descent ── */
.iw-cl .iwcl-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-cl .iwcl-stage{position:relative;overflow-x:auto}
.iw-cl .iwcl-stage svg{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.iw-cl .iwcl-v,.iw-cl .iwcl-h,.iw-cl .iwcl-leaf{stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:1.5;fill:none}
.iw-cl .iwcl-v.on,.iw-cl .iwcl-h.on,.iw-cl .iwcl-leaf.on{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.6}
.iw-cl .iwcl-node{fill:var(--paper);stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:1.5;cursor:pointer}
.iw-cl .iwcl-node:hover{stroke:var(--accent)}
.iw-cl .iwcl-node.on{fill:var(--accent);stroke:var(--accent)}
.iw-cl .iwcl-tick{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.4}
.iw-cl .iwcl-chit{fill:transparent;cursor:pointer}
.iw-cl .iwcl-lead{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1;opacity:.4}
/* Names and characters are HTML on top of the drawing, so they can wrap —
   SVG text cannot, and a character is a whole sentence. No clamp: -webkit-box
   does not wrap text the way a block does, and left the longest line hanging
   6px outside its own box. They are pushed apart after layout instead. */
.iw-cl .iwcl-ch{position:absolute;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;
  color:var(--accent);text-align:right;pointer-events:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  word-break:break-word}
.iw-cl .iwcl-lb{position:absolute;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-cl .iwcl-lb.on{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.iw-cl .iwcl-clade{opacity:.16;rx:6}
/* the clade bracket, in the right gutter — never over the taxon names */
.iw-cl .iwcl-brk{fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;opacity:.85}
.iw-cl .iwcl-cln{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);
  pointer-events:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-cl .iwcl-per text{fill:#fff;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-anchor:middle;text-transform:uppercase}
.iw-cl .iwcl-perleg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 14px;margin-top:7px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-cl .iwcl-perleg span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.iw-cl .iwcl-perleg i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px}
.iw-cl .iwcl-img{position:absolute;object-fit:contain}
.iw-cl .iwcl-read{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);min-height:1.7em}
.iw-cl .iwcl-read i{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-cl .iwcl-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── the niveau · durée · corrigés stamp, shared by exercise / twotier / method ── */
.iwmeta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 12px}
.iwmeta span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--slate);
  border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.iwmeta .iwmeta-lv{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.iwmeta .iwmeta-lv i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--accent);display:inline-block}
.iwmeta .iwmeta-lv i.on{background:var(--accent)}
.iwmeta .iwmeta-lv i+i{margin-left:-2px}
.iwmeta .iwmeta-r{color:var(--slate);font-style:normal}
.iw-method .iwmeta,.iw-tt .iwmeta{margin-top:2px}
/* what a worked example teaches you to do, before it does it */
.iw-method .iwme-skills{border-left:3px solid var(--gold);background:var(--paper-deep);
  border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:11px 14px;margin:0 0 14px}
.iw-method .iwme-skills b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:6px}
.iw-method .iwme-skills ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px}
.iw-method .iwme-skills li{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:3px 0}

/* ── sigfig: significant figures ── */
.iw-sf .iwsf-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-sf .iwsf-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px 14px;align-items:center;
  padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-list>.iwsf-row:first-child{border-top:0}
.iw-sf .iwsf-v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-sf .iwsf-v i{font-family:var(--sans,inherit);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic;margin-left:6px}
.iw-sf .iwsf-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.iw-sf .iwsf-in input{font:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;width:150px;padding:6px 10px;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);outline:none;text-align:right}
.iw-sf .iwsf-in input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-mark{width:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-style:normal}
.iw-sf .iwsf-row.ok .iwsf-mark::before{content:'✓';color:var(--teal)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-row.no .iwsf-mark::before{content:'✕';color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-row.ok input{border-color:var(--teal)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-row.no input{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-why{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);
  padding:2px 0 2px 2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-sf .iwsf-why b{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--teal);margin-right:2px}
.iw-sf .iwsf-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-top:14px}
.iw-sf .iwsf-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-score.ok{color:var(--teal)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-score.no{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sf .iwsf-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── examtips: the two columns of exam advice ── */
.iw-et .iwet-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.iw-et .iwet-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.iw-et .iwet-col{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px 12px;min-width:0}
.iw-et .iwet-lose{border-top:3px solid var(--accent)}
.iw-et .iwet-gain{border-top:3px solid var(--gold)}
.iw-et .iwet-h{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-et .iwet-col ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.iw-et .iwet-col li{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0}
.iw-et .iwet-col li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.iw-et .iwet-m{flex:0 0 19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-top:2px}
.iw-et .iwet-lose .iwet-m{background:var(--accent)}
.iw-et .iwet-gain .iwet-m{background:var(--gold);color:#1a1d26}
.iw-et .iwet-t{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-et .iwet-ref{display:inline-block;margin-left:7px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--slate);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:20px;padding:1px 8px;
  white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:1px}
.iw-et .iwet-note{margin-top:13px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── checklist: the reader ticks their own work ── */
.iw-ck .iwck-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-ck .iwck-g{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--slate);margin:14px 0 6px}
.iw-ck .iwck-g:first-child{margin-top:0}
.iw-ck .iwck-row{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  cursor:pointer;min-width:0}
.iw-ck .iwck-list>.iwck-row:first-child{border-top:0}
.iw-ck .iwck-row input{flex:0 0 auto;width:17px;height:17px;margin-top:2px;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.iw-ck .iwck-tx{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-ck .iwck-tx i{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-ck .iwck-row input:checked+.iwck-tx{color:var(--slate);text-decoration:line-through;
  text-decoration-color:var(--rule)}
.iw-ck .iwck-row input:checked+.iwck-tx i{text-decoration:none}
.iw-ck .iwck-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule);flex-wrap:wrap}
.iw-ck .iwck-bar{flex:1;min-width:110px;height:7px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--paper-deep);overflow:hidden}
.iw-ck .iwck-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--gold);border-radius:5px;transition:width .25s ease}
.iw-ck .iwck-bar i.full{background:var(--teal)}
.iw-ck .iwck-score{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-ck .iwck-score.ok{color:var(--teal)}
.iw-ck .iwck-note{margin-top:11px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── formulary: the sheet at the back of the book ── */
.iw-fy .iwfy-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-fy .iwfy-search input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
.iw-fy .iwfy-search input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.iw-fy .iwfy-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:14px}
.iw-fy .iwfy-grp{min-width:0}
.iw-fy .iwfy-g{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px}
.iw-fy .iwfy-item{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:9px;min-width:0}
.iw-fy .iwfy-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-fy .iwfy-expr{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:7px;
  overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:2px}
.iw-fy .iwfy-sym{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:2px 9px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5}
.iw-fy .iwfy-sym dt{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--slate);white-space:nowrap}
.iw-fy .iwfy-sym dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink-soft);min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.iw-fy .iwfy-use{margin-top:7px;padding-top:7px;border-top:1px dotted var(--rule);font-size:12.5px;
  line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-fy .iwfy-use b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-fy .iwfy-empty{margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--slate);font-style:italic}
.iw-fy .iwfy-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-style:italic}

/* ── vectors: arrows on squared paper ── */
.iw-vc .iwvc-intro{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.iw-vc .iwvc-stage{overflow-x:auto;text-align:center}
.iw-vc .iwvc-stage svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}
.iw-vc .iwvc-grid line{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1}
.iw-vc .iwvc-ax line{stroke:var(--slate);stroke-width:1.4}
.iw-vc .iwvc-cp line{stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 4;opacity:.55}
.iw-vc .iwvc-v{stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round;cursor:pointer}
.iw-vc .iwvc-v.on{stroke-width:4}
.iw-vc .iwvc-lb{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.iw-vc .iwvc-lb.on{font-size:13.5px}
.iw-vc .iwvc-keys{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:12px;justify-content:center}
.iw-vc .iwvc-key{font:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 11px;
  background:none;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-vc .iwvc-key i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;flex:0 0 auto}
.iw-vc .iwvc-key.on{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--ink)}
.iw-vc .iwvc-key b{font-weight:400;color:var(--slate)}
.iw-vc .iwvc-read{margin-top:10px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);

.iw-sol .iwsol-gap b{color:var(--accent)}
.iw-sol .iwsol-green p{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-sol .iwsol-weigh{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 18px}
.iw-sol .iwsol-weigh label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-sol .iwsol-weigh input{width:82px;margin:0 4px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px}
.iw-sol .iwsol-wout{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iw-sol .iwsol-wout b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;color:var(--ink)}
.iw-sol .iwsol-wout em{font-style:italic;color:var(--slate);font-size:12.5px}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .iw-sol .iwsol-date{margin-left:0;width:100%}
  .iw-sol .iwsol-brow{grid-template-columns:minmax(76px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);row-gap:2px}
  .iw-sol .iwsol-bv{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:left}
}

/* == carte ==================================================================
   Une pile d'etapes, chacune une carte complete. Rien n'est decoratif : la
   terre est un aplat neutre, la couleur appartient aux parties que l'auteur a
   coloriees, et la legende se dessine avec le meme code que la carte. */
.iw-map{--map-land:#e6e0d2;--map-stroke:rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
html.dark .iw-map{--map-land:#2a2f3a;--map-stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.iwm-host{position:relative}

.iwm-stage{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
.iwm-svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:74vh;touch-action:none}
.iwm-land path{fill:var(--map-land);stroke:var(--map-stroke);stroke-width:.5px;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;transition:fill .18s}
.iwm-land .iwm-named{cursor:pointer}
.iwm-land .iwm-named:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
/* une partie qui ouvre une seconde carte : un lisere, jamais une pastille */
.iwm-land .iwm-into{cursor:pointer;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1.7px}
.iwm-land .iwm-blank{fill:var(--iwm-qblank);stroke-dasharray:3 2;cursor:pointer}
.iwm-name{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600;fill:var(--ink);
  paint-order:stroke;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.iwm-lab{font-family:var(--sans);fill:var(--ink-soft);
  paint-order:stroke;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.iwm-has{cursor:pointer}
.iwm-has:hover{opacity:.82}
/* une annotation libre : l'auteur choisit sa couleur, donc pas de fill impose */
.iwm-free{font-weight:500}
.iwm-b{font-weight:700}
.iwm-i{font-style:italic}

/* == l'habillage : quadrillage, echelle, rose des vents ==
   Discret par construction. Un quadrillage qu'on remarque avant les cotes est
   un quadrillage rate ; une echelle qu'on ne trouve pas est une echelle inutile. */
.iwm-grid path{stroke:var(--map-stroke);fill:none;opacity:.34;
  stroke-dasharray:none;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;pointer-events:none}
.iwm-gtx{font-family:var(--mono);fill:var(--slate);opacity:.85;
  paint-order:stroke;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.iwm-sc0{fill:var(--ink);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:.4;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.iwm-sc1{fill:var(--paper);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:.4;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.iwm-nbg{fill:var(--paper);fill-opacity:.72;stroke:var(--rule);
  stroke-width:.8;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.iwm-nar{fill:var(--ink)}
.iwm-nn{font-weight:700;fill:var(--ink)}

/* le curseur des etapes */
.iwm-steps{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:0 0 10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.iwm-steps input[type=range]{flex:1 1 140px;min-width:110px;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.iwm-nav{width:28px;height:28px;flex:none;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;
  background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;line-height:1;transition:.14s}
.iwm-nav:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.iwm-steplab{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.iwm-stepn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--slate);letter-spacing:.08em}

.iwm-zoom{position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:4;display:flex;gap:4px}
/* legende a droite : les boutons de zoom passent a gauche, ils disparaissaient dessous */
.iwm-hasside .iwm-zoom{right:auto;left:8px}
.iwm-zoom button{width:26px;height:26px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;line-height:1;opacity:.85}
.iwm-zoom button:hover{opacity:1;border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}

.iwm-crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 9px}
.iwm-crumb span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.iwm-back{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink-soft);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;padding:5px 10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.14s}
.iwm-back:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}

/* == la legende ==
   Groupee par categorie, et chaque pastille est dessinee avec le meme code que
   l'objet qu'elle annonce : une route en pointille rouge se montre en
   pointille rouge, une aire hachuree avec ses hachures. */
.iwm-legend{margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.iwm-legend-t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:7px}
.iwm-lgroup{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 16px;margin-bottom:7px}
.iwm-lcat{width:100%;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ink);margin:3px 0 1px}
.iwm-lrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iwm-lnote{font-style:italic;color:var(--slate);font-size:12.5px}
.iwm-sw{width:26px;height:16px;flex:none;overflow:visible}
.iwm-lpick{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 5px 1px 3px}
.iwm-lpick:hover{border-color:var(--rule)}
.iwm-lpick.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(140,47,42,.09)}
/* une legende longue tient en colonnes plutot qu'en une bande de trois metres */
.iwm-l2,.iwm-l3{column-gap:26px}
@media (min-width:620px){ .iwm-l2{columns:2} .iwm-l3{columns:3} }
.iwm-l2 .iwm-lgroup,.iwm-l3 .iwm-lgroup{break-inside:avoid;display:block}
.iwm-l2 .iwm-lrow,.iwm-l3 .iwm-lrow{display:flex;margin-bottom:4px}
/* == la gamme d'une choroplethe ==
   Ses pastilles se TOUCHENT : c'est une echelle continue, pas une liste de
   symboles, et un ecart entre deux classes ferait croire a un trou. */
.iwm-ramp{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;gap:0}
.iwm-rstep{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:0 9px 0 0;white-space:nowrap}
.iwm-rstep i{width:22px;height:13px;flex:none;display:block;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.22);border-right:0}
.iwm-rstep:last-child i{border-right:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.iwm-lramp{margin-bottom:9px}
/* la legende sur le cote, quand la carte est haute et la place a droite libre */
@media (min-width:760px){
  /* Bornee en hauteur : une legende plus haute que la carte debordait par le bas. */
  .iwm-legend-side{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;z-index:3;max-width:38%;max-height:calc(100% - 20px);
    overflow:auto;margin:0;padding:10px 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;
    background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
  .iwm-legend-side .iwm-legend-t{margin-top:0}
}

/* == le quiz == */
.iwm-quiz{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.iwm-qscore{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.iwm-qin{font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;width:9.5em;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid var(--rule-2);
  border-radius:5px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.iwm-qin:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent)}
.iwm-qin.ok{border-color:#2f8a5b;background:rgba(47,138,91,.10)}
.iwm-qin.ko{border-color:#c0392b;background:rgba(192,57,43,.09)}

/* == la fiche au clic == */
.iwm-pop{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:5;
  max-width:min(430px,92%);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:9px;
  box-shadow:0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:13px 15px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.iwm-pop h4{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:14.5px}
.iwm-pop img{display:block;max-width:100%;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:9px}
.iwm-popx{position:absolute;top:5px;right:7px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--slate);
  font-size:17px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.iwm-popx:hover{color:var(--accent)}

@media print{.iwm-zoom,.iwm-nav,.iwm-quiz,.iwm-steps input{display:none}}
